title: Tiny, cute avocado
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Shadow-ish base glow on screen -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='22' ry='5' fill='#1a3a1a'/>
  <!-- Avocado outer skin -->
  <path d='M50 12 C32 12 22 30 22 50 C22 70 34 86 50 86 C66 86 78 70 78 50 C78 30 68 12 50 12 Z' fill='#2e6b1e'/>
  <!-- Skin lighter edge highlight -->
  <path d='M50 15 C34 15 25 31 25 50 C25 68 36 83 50 83 C64 83 75 68 75 50 C75 31 66 15 50 15 Z' fill='#3f8f2a'/>
  <!-- Flesh -->
  <path d='M50 22 C37 22 30 36 30 52 C30 68 39 80 50 80 C61 80 70 68 70 52 C70 36 63 22 50 22 Z' fill='#c8e86a'/>
  <!-- Flesh inner glow -->
  <path d='M50 26 C39 26 33 38 33 52 C33 66 41 77 50 77 C59 77 67 66 67 52 C67 38 61 26 50 26 Z' fill='#d9f28c'/>
  <!-- Pit -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='14' fill='#8a4b1e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#a8652a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Pit highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='52' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#c07f3f'/>
  <!-- Cute face on pit: eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='56' r='1.8' fill='#2b1400'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='56' r='1.8' fill='#2b1400'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44.3' cy='55.3' r='0.6' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='54.3' cy='55.3' r='0.6' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 62 Q50 66 55 62' fill='none' stroke='#2b1400' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='61' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#e88a5a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='61' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#e88a5a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Little leaf on top -->
  <path d='M50 14 Q56 4 66 6 Q60 14 50 14 Z' fill='#4fbf3a'/>
  <path d='M52 13 Q57 8 63 8' fill='none' stroke='#2e8f22' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
